title: Playing the part of a teacher, hero, or dog is listed at age 4
summary: By about age 4, CDC says most children take on another identity in play, such as a teacher, a superhero, or a dog.
body: The social section for 4 years includes pretending to be something else during play. The examples printed there are teacher, superhero, and dog. The child steps into a role another person could recognize. CDC counts the item at an age it ties to 75 percent or more of children, and it says the sheets are not a screening test. This role-taking line is the US page's own examples, not a script children must memorize.
